Not ranked: normal mode needs EN high as well as nSTB high (SLLSFD1F Table 7-4, read 2026-09-28T13:37:27Z). With EN held high, nSTB low gives Standby only while the wake-request flag is set and Sleep once it is cleared; with EN held low, nSTB high gives Silent, so the driver never runs. Holding Standby from the enable node alone needs EN and nSTB driven together, which the datasheet does not describe. It also needs a VSUP pin (4.5 to 40 V) and SOIC-14. Its other figures pass: tMODE2 10 µs, ±58 V, tPROP(LOOP1) 215 ns and (LOOP2) 205 ns max, nSTB ILKG(OFF) ±1 µA.

P3 shows a SON-8 rule-5 alternate, TCAN1044AVDRBRQ1 (C3234119, JLCPCB 41,538, presale 41,319, 13:36:13Z), so the P2 exclusion does not hold. Qualified, it ranks below the five: Digi-Key 0 (13:37:04Z), so its second source rests on that alternate, and 3.5061 at 10 (JLCPCB 1,900, presale 1,481, 13:36:11Z), the highest price of the external candidates.
